description:
Treat a file under an issue's resolved artifact directory as that issue's document by location, so that artifacts need an explicit link only when they live elsewhere.

## Background

Every durable artifact must be linked to its issue to be discoverable and to pass artifact-layout review. Workers in linked worktrees cannot write tracker state, so each worker reports a list of paths and the lead links them after merging; a forgotten link costs a review round. The artifact directory an issue owns is already resolved by the repository's layout, so location alone already says which issue a file belongs to.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Listing an issue's documents includes every file under its resolved artifact directory without an explicit link.
- [hard] REQ-02: Link checking, validation and artifact-layout conformance treat such a file as tracked.
- [hard] REQ-03: An explicit link is required only for a path outside the issue's artifact directory, and explicit links to paths inside it are removed from existing records.
- [hard] REQ-04: Artifacts a worker commits in a linked worktree under the issue's artifact directory are linked once the branch merges, with no tracker write.

## Notes

- Open design point: explicit links carry a document type and label; whether a derived document's type comes from its name or location, or whether the field is dropped, is decided in planning.
title: Derive an issue's documents from its artifact directory
